title: Parcel Event Flow
summary: Fictional sample for testing the reusable atlas.
scope: Static inspection of a fictional two-class fixture; no delivery system is executed.

pages.title: Shipment event routing
pages.summary: Read the event, choose an action, then hand it to the engine.

nodes.title: ShipmentRouter
nodes.detail: Choose the next action for one shipment event.

reader.overview: Choose the next action for one shipment event.
reader.inputs: A shipment event with a kind and payload.
steps: Log the event as diagnostic context.
Reject a missing event with Error.INVALID_EVENT.
Use CREATE_LABEL for a created event; use UPDATE_TRACKING otherwise.
reader.outcome: The selected action and original event are passed to RouteEngine.

nodes.title: RouteEngine
nodes.detail: Accept the event and action selected by the router.

reader.overview: Accept the event and action selected by the router.
reader.inputs: The original shipment event and a DispatchAction enum.
steps: Create the accepted result from the supplied event and action.
reader.outcome: Returns a DispatchResult; downstream delivery internals are not present in this fixture.

edges.label: Selected DispatchAction
edges.explanation: The router passes the same event and either DispatchAction.CREATE_LABEL or DispatchAction.UPDATE_TRACKING into the engine.
